parts: the vector is model$cpo$failure which should be a vector of zeros. but some of the values I have  are greater than zero. will using grid strategy for the integration technique (as against the default CCD) correct this?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Re: problem in numerical integration
parts:
The grid strategy will not help. there is a function 'inla.cpo' which
will compute 'manually' the problematic points; see ?inla.cpo

compare with the old values, and if there isn't much change, you know
for the future that its about fine.
